neighbours.label: acting so as not to be seen or detected (hiding, sneaking, 'so that no one would see'), against the same scene done openly
fire: He waited until the guards had turned away so that nobody would notice him leave.
The thieves wore dark clothes to avoid being spotted by the cameras.
She crept down the stairs quietly lest her parents hear her.
The lion crouched in the tall grass, hidden from the grazing antelope.
They met in secret so that their families would never find out.
The soldier kept low behind the wall to stay out of sight of the snipers.
He tucked the letter under his coat before anyone could see it.
The fox hid in the hedge until the hounds had passed.
quiet: He waited until the guards had turned away and then asked them for directions.
The thieves wore dark clothes because the night was cold.
She walked down the stairs quickly to greet her parents.
The lion lay in the tall grass, watching the grazing antelope.
They met in a cafe so that their families could celebrate together.
The soldier stood behind the wall and waved to the arriving trucks.
He handed the letter to his friend and asked her to read it.
The fox ran across the hedge and into the open field.

notes: Card is gate-closed dominated (61%) with 'lest they should see', 'stealthily', 'keeps people from seeing'; + pole promotes hide/conceal. Probe: 'so that no one would see' 0.478, wolves waiting before attack 0.231, avoid being recognized 0.213; open controls 0.047-0.073.
